'''Premiere Unlimited '95''' is the fourth expansion and the second reprint of the base set for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]  published by [[Decipher]] in June 1995. This set consists of 363 cards with images from all seasons of the '''Star Trek: The Next Generation''' television series.

This set is available in 60-card starter decks and 15-card booster packs. There are 36 booster packs in one booster box and 12 starter decks in a starter deck box. The starter decks include a 36 page Rules booklet.

The starter decks contain 45 commons, 13 uncommons, and 2 rares. Each booster pack contains 11 commons, 3 uncommons, and 1 rare.

The difference between this set and '''[[Premiere Limited (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Premiere Limited]]''' are the white borders on the cards and the copyright year. The difference with '''[[Premiere Unlimited '94]]''' is the copyright year on the cards. In addition, seventeen (17) cards from '''[[Premiere Limited (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Premiere Limited]]''' and '''[[Premiere Unlimited '94]]''' have corrections made (typographical errors corrected, game lore modified, etc.)

A small amount (approximately 1000) of the Star Trek the Next Generation CCG '''[[Premiere Unlimited '95]]''' set were offered for sale as uncut sheet sets directly by the manufacturer [[Decipher]] through mail order back in the early '90s. These prints have the "Official Uncut Sheet Collectable" seal on the back of each card in the lower right corner. The seal includes the signature of Warren L. Holland, then Chairman & CEO of [[Decipher]]. Each press set consists of three sheets measuring 38 3/4 inches x 28 1/8 inches containing 121 cards each in an 11 by 11 card layout. One sheet has all 121 common cards, one sheet has all 121 uncommon cards, and one sheet has all 121 rare cards (total of 3 sheets = 3 x 121 = 363 complete set of CCG cards). Each set comes with an official Certificate of Authenticity issued by the manufacturer. These uncut sheets were never sold at retail. An exclusive limited time offer was made to owners of '''[[The Fajo Collection]]''' with a special coupon included in each boxed set purchased. This limited time offer expired December 31, 1998. An exclusive limited time offer was also included with boxes of '''[[Official Tournament Sealed Deck]]''' purchased. This limited time offer expired December 31, 1999. At the conclusion of the mail-in offer, the leftovers were cut up and sold as card sets. This makes the uncut sheets and the cut “uncut” card sets the rarest Star Trek CCG set of all.

==Additional Information==
*'''Premiere Unlimited '95''' was printed on 121 card sheets by Carta Mundi, Belgium on Superlux card stock. Each rarity (Common, Uncommon, and Rare) had its own print sheet.
*Each print sheet consisted of an 11 x 11 format.
*The print run for this expansion was 45,900,000 cards.
